description.en:
Our handheld vacuum cleaners are designed for maximum convenience without compromising on power. Featuring a high-speed brushless motor, washable HEPA filter, and USB-C fast charging, they deliver reliable performance for every quick clean-up task.

Whether you are tidying the car interior, cleaning pet hair from sofas, or handling daily kitchen messes, the compact yet powerful design ensures thorough suction. The wet & dry capability handles spills and debris alike, making it the perfect companion for home, office, and travel.

As an OEM/ODM manufacturer, we support custom branding, colors, and packaging to match your market requirements. MOQ starts at 500 units with a 25-35 day production lead time.
description.zh:
我们的手持吸尘器以最大化便利性而不牺牲吸力为设计理念。搭载高速无刷电机、可水洗HEPA滤网和USB-C快充，为每次快速清洁提供可靠性能。

无论是清理汽车内饰、沙发上的宠物毛发，还是处理日常厨房污渍，紧凑而强大的设计确保彻底吸尘。干湿两用能力可同时处理液体泼洒和碎屑，是家庭、办公室和旅行的完美伴侣。

作为OEM/ODM制造商，我们支持定制品牌、颜色和包装以匹配您的市场需求。最小起订量500台，大货交期25-35天。

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: I was skeptical ordering a vacuum from China but the build quality surprised me completely. The suction is powerful for its size, and it lasts 30+ minutes on a single charge. Attached are some photos of it cleaning our hardwood floors and the pet hair on our sofa.
_schema_reviews.name: Best cordless vacuum I have ever owned

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: As a small retailer, finding a supplier willing to do small batches was tough. Damaijia accepted our 200-unit order with no hassle. The vacuum itself is sleek and works great on both carpet and hard floors. The 3 included attachments cover everything we need.
_schema_reviews.name: Perfect for our apartment — and the MOQ was just 200 units

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: Ordered 300 units for our retail chain. The product quality is consistent across the batch — no complaints from our customers so far. Shipping took about 12 days to Valencia port. One suggestion: include a wall-mount bracket in the package.
_schema_reviews.name: Great value, fast shipping to EU
